mc.prompt: Which statement correctly describes the human yolk sac?
mc.answer: It has early developmental roles, including blood-cell formation
mc.explanation: The name does not imply a large food-yolk store in humans.

It is the main store of food for the entire pregnancy

The allantois is the adult ovary

writing.prompt: Compare the amnion and chorion using their positions and functions.
writing.model: The amnion encloses the fluid-filled cavity around the embryo or fetus and helps provide physical protection. The chorion is an outer extraembryonic membrane; its villi contribute to the fetal portion of the placenta and provide a large exchange interface.

worked.title: Distinguish a membrane from a vessel
worked.scenario: A diagram shows a fluid-filled space around the fetus and a separate cord connecting it with the placenta.
steps: The boundary around the fluid-filled space is the amnion.
The contents are amniotic fluid, not the membrane itself.
The cord contains fetal vessels for transport to and from the placenta.
The placenta is the exchange organ at the uterine interface; the cord is the connection to it.

worked.title: Explain the origin of an internal structure
worked.scenario: A student says the spinal cord cannot arise from ectoderm because ectoderm is the outer layer.
steps: Begin with early position: neural tissue begins in a specialized region of ectoderm.
Follow the movement: the neural plate forms folds, which meet and close.
The resulting neural tube lies below the surface.
Therefore an initially outer layer can give rise to an internal structure through morphogenesis.
